Optional: to run GENESIS fully offline, save these two files here:
  three.min.js      from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js
  OrbitControls.js  from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.128.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js
GENESIS uses these local copies first and falls back to the internet (CDN) if they are missing.
